node.statement: Fix an arbitrary W and an arbitrary explicit Stage-3 datum satisfying every hypothesis of node 1. Since t<=W.e_cross<=e_3, rho<=C_cross^0*t, and epsilon_{A_R}<=t, one has rho+epsilon_{A_R}<=(C_cross^0+1)*t<=(C_cross^0+1)*e_3<=a_merge. Thus this amplified four-corner merging datum, whose four fixed level-one maps are bijective, satisfies the smallness hypothesis of lem-extcb-four-corner-merge.
